$comment: The projects made from this template, by the names a shipped skill must never carry. A downstream project's core-purity gate refuses a first-party skill that names a product, so a template skill that names one is refused when it is synced there. pnpm verify:skill-neutrality reads this list and fails any file under .claude/skills/ that names one of these names as a whole word, in any letter case: a product name also covers the slug, the package scope (@name/) and the bundle id (com.name.app) built from it, so only names that are not part of another are listed. Each project's names are the identity that project declares: Certifipago's are the product and the repository of the identity block of its .agents/harness.config.json, whose package scope, slug and bundle id the product name covers; Qik is known here by its name only. Its vocabulary (domain terms, competitors, variable names) is not a project's name and stays out. This file names donor products, so it is template-maintainer material and never ships (docs/manifest.md); in a derived project the gate finds it absent and forbids nothing, while the template, the checkout whose .agents/harness.config.json identity is the template's own (scripts/template-identity.mjs), fails without it. A new downstream project adds its entry here.
